MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
25003806
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01203224
NATIONSTAR MORTGAGE LLC, is the
Plaintiff, and PALLAVI CHATURVEDI,
ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of
execution for the sale of mortgaged
premises dated 9/15/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 11TH DAY of
FEBRUARY A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty o' clock by the then
prevailing (Standard or Daylight
Saving) time, in the afternoon of
the said day, at the Heidrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick,
N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP OF NORTH
BRUNSWICK, County of Middlesex
and State of New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 5
LAKE DRIVE, NORTH BRUNSWICK,
NJ 08902.
Tax Lot: 1.02, Tax Block: 227.03
Approximate Dimensions: 0.46
Acres 3,621 sq. ft.
Nearest Cross Street: PLEASANT
PLACE.
Upset Price: $296,500.00.
Occupancy Status: Vacant.
Access: Does not have access to
property.
A FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION OF THE
PREMISES CAN BE FOUND IN THE
OFFICE OF THE SHERIFF OF MIDDLESEX COUNTY.
The sale is subject to any unpaid
taxes and assessments, tax, water,
and sewer liens and other municipal
assessments. The amount due can
be obtained from the local taxing
authority.
ALL INTERESTED PARTIES ARE TO
CONDUCT AND RELY UPON THEIR
OWN INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATION TO ASCERTAIN WHETHER OR
NOT ANY OUTSTANDING INTEREST
REMAIN OF RECORD AND/OR HAVE
PRIORITY OVER THE LIEN BEING
FORECLOSED AND, IF SO THE
CURRENT AMOUNT DUE
THEREON. **IF THE SALE IS SET
ASIDE FOR ANY REASON, THE
PURCHASER AT THE SALE SHALL BE
ENTITLED ONLY TO A RETURN OF
THE DEPOSIT PAID. THE
PURCHASER SHALL HAVE NO
FURTHER RECOURSE AGAINST THE
PLAINTIFF'S, ITS SUCCESSORS AND
ASSIGNS OR PLAINTIFF'S ATTORN EY (S)
NOTICE Regarding the Community
Wealth Preservation Program
On January 12, 2024 Gov. Murphy
signed lesislation into state law
establishing a Community Wealth
Preservation Program to promote
equity and fairness in foreclosure
sales by providing new and greater
opportunities for foreclosed-upon
residents and their next of kin,
tenants, and other prospective
owner-occupants, along with
nonprofit community development
corporations, to purchase and
finance a foreclosed-upon home.
THIS PROGRAM EXCLUDES THOSE
PURCHASING PROPERTY FOR
INVESTMENTS PURPOSES. For
further information, see P.L.2023,
c.255, or visit
https://pub.njleg.state.nj.us/Bills/2
022/A6000/5664_R3.PD.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of TWO HUNDRED EIGHTY
THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED NINETY
SEVEN DOLLARS AND FIFTEEN
CENTS($280,497.15) dollars more
or less, plus interest together with
the costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official bank check at
close of sale and the balance in two
weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Albertelli Law
14000 Commerce Parkway
Suite H
Mount Laurel, NJ 08054
Attorneys
